result.summary: Refactor CWallet::IsSpent to delegate directly to CWallet::HowSpent instead of duplicating the spend-check traversal. An optional boolean flag is added to HowSpent to support early exit as soon as any non-conflicted spend is detected, and IsSpent is converted into an inline header wrapper.

result.card: This PR refactors CWallet::IsSpent to call CWallet::HowSpent instead of maintaining duplicate traversal logic over mapTxSpends. HowSpent receives an optional boolean flag to early-exit as soon as an outpoint is confirmed spent, and IsSpent becomes an inline one-line wrapper in wallet.h. This is an internal code deduplication follow-up to PR #33671 with no user-facing changes or open dependencies.
